messages.subject: error in the run INLA
parts:
Hello.
I have data that is related to the spatial point pattern. To determine its intensity function, I used the Gaussian Cox processes, and I used the inla approximation to model and fit it.
My model is as bellow

form <- y ~ 0 + b0 +
    f(z1, model=spde, group=z1.group, 
      control.group=list(model='ar1', hyper=list(theta=pcrho)))
earth.fit1 <- inla(form, family='poisson',
                 data=inla.stack.data(stk), E=expect,
                 control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk)),
                 control.inla=list(strategy='gaussian'))

In the Run of command "m.prj" it gave me the bellow error:

Error in projector$proj$A %*% as.vector(field) :   not-yet-implemented method for <dgCMatrix> %*% <NULL>
coulde you helpe me about it.
Best regardes
Fatemeh
